name: Pecöl (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pecöl: a crowned blue shield with two red hearts, a white wavy stripe and a bird, above a scroll inscribed PECÖL.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pecöl arms with crown and scroll
